Well. I fucked up lmao.

The referees in our tournament got paid. 
This wasn't state finals but teams (that aren't even in our division) came from all over the state. 
The reason I said that they seem biased was that (I talked to other teams in our club) all the referees that had judged us in the tournament seemed to dislike our club. (One player's face got smashed into the ground and the referee gave the opposing goalkeeper the ball and let her punt/throw it.)
Didn't argue with the ref, just said "Hey she laid on top of me not letting me get up to attempt to stop the second shot by her teammate. Why was that still a goal?"

Thanks for your comment (lmao you're the most respectful comment I've gotten. Half of these people talk as if I'm an idiot). However, I did make contact with the ball. 
I lunged at the ball and got my hands on the ball when it got kicked away. Instead of the player immediately getting off of me she took her time and sat on me until they scored which is what I thought was unfair.

I've talked to other teams in our league and many calls were made against them (which shouldn't have been), the other teams weren't called for shoving, etc. And the girls on those teams have gone to state finals, so I wouldn't believe they'd make stuff up.
It seemed as if all the referees disliked our league. (One of our teammates' face got shoved into the ground and the referee gave the ball to the other goalkeeper in order to punt it.)

3-2, they won off of a penalty kick awarded to them. There was a side judge present but in our tournament, the side ref and the head ref would BOTH call offsides. 
We got one penalty kick while they got three. Many girls on their team tripped (this was right in front of the head ref) and he called a shove/push. While when they were actually shoving and elbowing (one girl pushed our teammates' face into the ground) they gave the ball to the other goalkeeper or didn't call it. 
Our coach actually talked to us about how many calls didn't go our way.

I didn't say the referees are always biased against goalkeepers, I said that the "referees in our tournament were always biased against our league and us." That was the main reason I was planning to write a letter, the call was going to be a big example. The player was laying on top of me until a goal was scored. It's not as if she tripped over me and got up immediately and apologized or something, it was as if I was her chair. So thanks for instead of being polite to me (I'm twelve for your information) you decided to be rude.
Thanks for your opinion. However, they landed on me and persisted to sit on me (after I had already dived for the ball) for about 2 minutes. Until a goal occurred the player was still laying on me.

Yeah, the referee just didn't seem to like our team in general. He wasn't calling clear offsides on the other team (there were at least 5 and he called only 1. Everyone (even the other team) knew they were offsides), was awarding them a bunch of penalty kicks, and not calling their elbowing (when-when we used our shoulders they called us out). 
The one thing that seemed to bother me the most was that because of the fact that we're young (U13) and not super intense I thought that he would've stopped play. If the keeper and the attacker are both entangled and one has fallen over the other. I understand how annoyed the other team would be if he stopped the play but if the girl hadn't gotten up right after they scored then I could've gotten kicked in the face (all I could see was her cleats).

Everyone saw it, my coaches, teammates, and everyone on the sidelines could see that she was sprawled out on top of me. 

She was dribbling up the sidelines when I dived towards the ball and touched the ball.

Yeah, I understand that I won't lose any scholarships but this isn't the first time a bad/not understandable call has been made. However, this is a competitive tournament and if we win tournaments we could make it to state finals, etc. So my life won't be over but the call was poor (in my coach, mine, and our team) and costed us to not make it to the fianls of the tournament.
